for: The presentation: the slide "Care is part of the architecture". Not placed in the deck yet.
shows: One pier of the room, R1.P1, straight on from outside, fixed: its four climbers on the timber through 2032, their sixth year. The year turns slowly; the climbers leaf, flower, colour and drop their leaves as the simulator's seasons say. On each of the eleven days the simulated gardener comes, time holds, what is cut that day shows in red, one sentence says the job, and it is gone. The large number is the metres of stem cut at this pier so far this year. Drag to move through the year.
statement: Every stem, leaf, flower and cut is one run of the plant simulator (one seed, provisional species numbers); the gardener is the simulator's rule-based gardener, not a record of a person's work. Leaves and flowers are plain marks; stems under 14 mm are drawn 14 mm wide. The timber and cables are the building model's. A scenario, not a forecast.
